question: Arjuna awardee Dr Ajmer Singh is associated with which game?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Athletics.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr Ajmer Singh** is associated with the game of **Athletics**, which involves track and field events like **running, jumping, and throwing.**
 
• He has been honored with the prestigious **Arjuna Award** for his contribution to the sport of Athletics in India.
 
• Dr Ajmer Singh has represented India in several international events like the **Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, and the Olympics.**
 
• He has also served as a coach and mentor to several** young athletes** in the country, helping them to achieve their full potential in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football** is a popular team sport played with a** ball.**

 
 
• **Britain** is where modern football had its start in the **1800s.**
 
 
 
• **Table Tennis** is an** indoor racket sport** played on a table.
 
 
• When the game was first created in England at the beginning of the** 20th century,** it was known by the trade name Ping-Pong.
 
• When the former **Ping-Pong Association,** founded in **1902, **was resurrected in **1921–1922,** the term table tennis was chosen.
 
 
 
• **Badminton **is another racket sport played with a **shuttlecock** and is also a popular sport in India.
 
 
• The game of badminton got its name when the **Duke of Beaufort **introduced the sport to his country estate in **1873.**
